commits.subject: feat(agent): add attention notification system via Claude Code hooks
commits.body:
Add hook-based notification system that detects when Claude needs attention
(permission, input, plan approval, task complete) and broadcasts status
updates to connected browsers via WebSocket.

- Add SessionStatus, AttentionReason types to shared package
- Add DB migration v17 with status tracking columns
- Create /api/hooks/status endpoint for hook notifications
- Add broadcastStatusUpdate() to WebSocket handlers
- Create notify-247.sh hook script in packages/hooks

commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: feat(cli): add hooks command for Claude Code notification hooks
commits.body:
Add `247 hooks` CLI command to manage Claude Code notification hooks:
- `247 hooks install` - Install hooks with version checking
- `247 hooks uninstall` - Remove hooks from settings and filesystem
- `247 hooks status` - Show installation status and version info
- `247 hooks update` - Update hooks to latest version

The hooks system:
- Copies notify-247.sh to ~/.247/hooks/
- Registers Notification hook in ~/.claude/settings.json
- Supports version detection and automatic updates
- Integrated into `247 doctor` diagnostics

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.body:
- Add individual column checks and error handling
- Verify columns were actually added after migration
- Throw error if migration fails instead of silently continuing
- Handle partial migrations from previous failed attempts
